title: E.l.f. Brands opts for ‘handcrafted’ stop motion Christmas campaign instead of AI
summary: The beauty company’s 60-second ‘e.l.f. Made to Stand Out’ 2026 Christmas campaign has been created using stop motion filmmaking techniques to celebrate ‘human creativity’ and is narrated by Tony Award-winning actor Alan Cumming

extraction.key_fact: E.l.f. Brands가 AI 대신 스톱모션 기법으로 크리스마스 캠페인을 만들었다.
